paite: Akum sagih kum in Jehoiada akihatsak a, sepaih zaheutu, Jehoram tapa Azariah, Jehohanan tapa Ishmael, Obed tapa Azariah, Adaiah tapa Maaseiah, Jikri tapa Elisaphath kiang ah thu akhung hi.
heading: Athaliah Kalh A Helna / (2 Kum 11.4-16)

paite: Huchi in Judah gam ah avak ua, Judah gam kho chih a Levite leh Israel inkuan intekte akaikhawm ua, Jerusalem ava tungtou uhi.
Kikaikhawmte tengteng in Pathian inn ah kumpipa kiang ah thu akhung uhi. Huan akiang uah, "Ngai dih ua, TOUPA'N David tapate tungtang thu ana gen bang in kumpipa tapa in vai ahawm ding ahi.
Na hih ding uh hichibang ahi, siampute leh Levite Sabbath ni a hong kuansekte seh thum a khen seh khat kongkhak ngak mite na hi ding ua;
seh thum a khen seh khat kumpipa' inn ah na om ding ua; huan seh thum a khen seh khat kulh kongpi ah; mipi tengteng bel TOUPA intual sung ah a-om ding uh.
Himahleh, siampute leh nasemmi Levite kia lou ngal kuamah TOUPA' inn ah lut kei un, amau bel asiangthou ziak un alut ding ua, mipi tengteng bel TOUPA hungaih in a-om ding uhi.
Levite'n agalvan uh tawi in kumpipa a-um ding ua; kuapeuh inn a hong lut thah ding ahi a; huan kumpipa apawt leh alut in amah kiang ah om zel un," achi hi.

Huchi in Levite leh Judah tengteng in siampu Jehoiada thupiak bang in ahih ua; amaute heute chiat Sabbath ni a hong kuan dingte leh Sabbath ni a tawp dingte api ua; siampu Jehoiada in atawp ding pawl lah atawpsak nai kei hi.
heading: Joash Kumpi A Bawlna

paite: Siampu Jehoiada in sepaih za heutute ToUPA' inn a om kumpipa David tei leh lum neu leh lum liante apia hi.
Huan mite galvan tawi chiat in taklam sang a kipan in veilam sang tan in maitam leh inn um in kumpipa a-umsak uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa tapa ahon pikhia ua, lallukhu akhusak ua, theihsakna thu apia ua, kumpipa in abawl ua, Jehoiada leh atapate'n thau anilh ua, "Pathian in kumpipa hondam hen," achi uhi.
Athaliah in mipi kumpipa pahtawi a mipi kiphu motmot husa azak in TOUPA' inn ah mipi lak ah ava hoh hi.
heading: Athaliah Thahna

paite: A-en a, ngai in, kongpi a khuambul ah kumpipa adingh a, akiang ah sepaih heutute leh pengkul mut mite toh; huai gam a mi tengteng in nuam asa mahmah ua, pengkulte amut zuazua ua; lasa mite'n athil gingtheite uh tum in phatna la asakhawm uhi. Huchi in Athaliah in apuante abotkek a, "Kiphialgukna; kiphialgukna ahi ve," achi hi.

Huan siampu Jehoiada in sepaihte tung a heutu dia seh sepaih za heutute apikhia a, akiang uah, "Sepaihte kikal ah pawtsak unla, huan kuapeuh azuizui namsau a satlup hi hen," achi hi. Siampu in, "TOUPA' inn ah zaw thah ding ahi kei," achita hi.
Huchi in lampi a-awn ua, sakol lutna kongpi ah kumpipa' inn ah ahoh a, huai ah athat uhi.
Huan Jehoiada in amah leh mipi tengteng leh kumpipa kikal ah TOUPA mite hi ding in thu akhung hi.
heading: Jehoiada Puahthakna / (2 Kum 11.17-20)

paite: Mipi tengteng Baal inn ah ahoh ua, ahihsia ua, amaitamte, alimte ahihtam dimdem ua, Baal siampu Matan, maitam bul ah athat uhi.

Jehoiada in, Mosi Dan Bu a gelh bang a nuamsatak leh la sa kawm a, David in TOUPA' inn a TOUPA kiang a halmang thillat lan ding a ana seh siampu Levite nuai a sem ding in David thupiak bang in TOUPA' inn ngakmi dingte asep hi.
Siangthou lou peuhmah alutlouhna ding un TOUPA' inn kongkhak ngak mite asep hi.

Huan zakhat tung a heutute, mihoihte, mipi uk mite, huai gammi tengteng api a, TOUPA' inn a kumpipa apikhia ua; kongkhak saknungzaw ah kumpipa' inn lam ah ahoh ua, kumpipa agam laltutphah ah atusakta uhi.
Huchi in namsau a Athaliah athah nung un huai gam a mi tengteng nuamsatak in a-om ua, khopi galmuang in a-omta hi.
